title: StatCompare
wikitext: StatCompare is designed for gear checks and player comparisons. It provides detailed character and target gear stats, talents, buffs, enchants, and custom abilities, making it a valuable tool for raiders, guilds, and gear evaluators. == Installation == '''GitAddonsManager''' The easiest way to keep '''StatCompare''' up to date is by using [[GitAddonsManager]]. # '''Add the Repository:''' Add the following URL to GitAddonsManager: https://github.com/grimfiendish/StatCompare.git # '''Select the Branch:''' Ensure that the master branch is selected. # '''Update:''' Using GitAddonsManager, you can check for and install updates for all your AddOns with a single click. '''Manual Installation''' If you prefer manual installation, follow these steps: # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Unpack the .zip and rename the folder to StatCompare, removing the -master suffix. # Move the folder into your Interface/AddOns directory and restart the game. '''Optional''': [[BetterCharacterStats]] == Git Links == * [https://github.com/grimfiendish/StatCompare/ '''(grimfiendish)'''] == Commands == * '''Enable:''' /statc on * '''Disable:''' /statc off * '''Debug Mode on:''' /statc debug on * '''Debug Mode off:''' /statc debug off * '''Open Options:''' /statc config * '''Show Item Collection:''' /statc item * '''Compare Sets / Gear:''' /statc sets * '''Help & Info:''' /statc help == Usage == * '''View Your Own Stats:''' Use c key to open the stats panel for your character. * '''Gear Checks:''' Take screenshots of your gear or view detailed stats of inspection targets. * '''Selective Display:''' Toggle info with icons at the top-right: ** Armor & Enchants ** Spell Info ** Character Stats == Preview == Options: [[File:Sc1.png|frameless|401x401px]] StatCompare: [[File:Sc.png|frameless|405x405px]] == Features == * '''Character Stats & Resistances:''' Attack Power, Spell Power, Resistances, Hit, Crit, and more. * '''Gear & Enchants:''' Lists equipped items and their enchantments. * '''Talent Tree Summary:''' Shows your talent specialization. * '''Active Buffs:''' Displays current buffs that may influence stats. * '''Custom Abilities:''' Supports abilities like Haste, Vampirism, Crusader Strike. == Compatibility == * Works with standard WoW 1.12.1 client. * Supports private servers with custom abilities. * Adjustments may be needed for server-specific features. * Supports Chinese (zhCN) and English. == Credits == * '''Author:''' slashboy @ 九藜方舟 Dreamland * '''Modified & Maintained by:''' lasthime @ 艾森纳 * '''Contributors:''' 狗血编剧男, Provocateur @ TurtleWow == Version History == * '''v1.8.000:''' Added gear item names and enchant info for raid checks. * '''v1.7.010:''' Improved compatibility, fixed bug with armor type display, added shift-click to insert items into chat. * '''v1.7.005:''' Support for gear set bonuses, set property detection. * '''v1.6 & earlier:''' Supported detailed resistances, spell damage, and extensive passive bonuses, with support for private server abilities and custom enchantments.
